content.short: Hashflow is a multi-chain DEX using a Request-for-Quote (RFQ) model to provide zero slippage and MEV protection.
content.description: Hashflow is a decentralized exchange (DEX) designed for high-performance trading with zero slippage and MEV-protected execution. Unlike traditional AMMs, Hashflow uses a Request-for-Quote (RFQ) model that allows professional market makers to provide liquidity directly to users. This ensures traders receive the best prices without front-running risks. The protocol supports seamless cross-chain swaps, bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized liquidity. Hashflow provides institutional-grade features to the Web3 community while maintaining the security of on-chain settlement.
